vulnerabilities.title: Negative Button Present - Bypass Risk
vulnerabilities.description: BiometricPrompt is configured with a negative button that allows users to bypass biometric authentication entirely without providing credentials.
vulnerabilities.impact: An attacker with physical device access can bypass biometric authentication by tapping the cancel/negative button.
vulnerabilities.mitigation: Remove setNegativeButtonText() and use setDeviceCredentialAllowed(true) for fallback authentication.
